travelers_hood.name: TRAVELER HOOD
travelers_hood.description: A weathered hood. It keeps the ash out of your eyes.

wardens_helm.name: WARDEN HELM
wardens_helm.description: Iron once worn by a sentinel of the old road.

ashplate_armor.name: ASHPLATE ARMOR
ashplate_armor.description: Scorched plates bound with wire. Heavy, but honest.

veilweave_robe.name: VEILWEAVE ROBE
veilweave_robe.description: Cloth threaded with threads of the Void itself.

gravesteel_plate.name: GRAVESTEEL PLATE
gravesteel_plate.description: Forged from grave iron. The dead remember its weight.

ashen_gauntlets.name: ASHEN GAUNTLETS
ashen_gauntlets.description: Reinforced gloves for a hand that never stops swinging.

voidweave_gloves.name: VOIDWEAVE GLOVES
voidweave_gloves.description: Stitched with dark sinew that guides the blade.

wayfarer_boots.name: WAYFARER BOOTS
wayfarer_boots.description: Broken in on a hundred roads through the ash.

stalker_boots.name: STALKER BOOTS
stalker_boots.description: Silent soles, favoured by those who hunt in the veil.

guardian_greaves.name: GUARDIAN GREAVES
guardian_greaves.description: Shards of the shrine warden's armour, still faintly warm.
